title: Eval run · MCP ask round day 1 · travel_expense × 2 arms × 1 rep · b8408d82 · 2026-11-17
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir

Day 1 of the daily MCP ask round (#34869), run by hand by seat 3's area o3-F because no eval seat is on duty. The open runner's ask mode asks through `/api/v1/mcp` on a locally booted app with a general Claude Code client. No cloud access and no API key are involved. This is a server-side reading of matching, compilation, permissions and labels. It is not the product baseline.

## Environment

- Runner: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main `b8408d82` (includes #34911, the managed-install fallback for ask mode, and #34882, the asked-back grader fix). `@objectstack/scenarios` `run-scenarios --modes ask`.
- Packages: published 18.5.0 (`--create-version 18.5.0`). Mode: ask over a supplied verified build (`--template`).
- Driver and login: `claude -p` from Claude Code 2.1.326, login `oauth_token` (subscription). `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were unset.
- Served model: `claude-haiku-5-5` on every ask turn (requested `--ask-model haiku`). Requested effort: `medium`.
- Cost: the CLI's notional figure. Nothing is billed per token under a subscription login.

## Scope

- Card: `travel_expense` (control tier), ask only, from its verified build (template sha256 `b7ab31a715d4e83ce35c5075739f2d10b9bf7e8f0bf3b577709ae7d953de8377`). There was no build half or iterate.
- Configs: 2 arms on the same model and effort. **no-skill** has no skills. **with-skill** has `--ask-skills` with the `objectstack-ask` bundle.
- Repetitions: 1 per arm (`--ask-repeats 1`).
- Per repetition: 13 ask turns. 5 questions were graded and 3 operations were graded. Both commands exited 0.
- Install: the unmanaged install was refused `422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`, and the same build was installed **managed** (runner finding, #34911).
- Seed: 173/757 rows loaded on both arms. 584 were refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` by the build's own rule: a paid claim cannot be inserted, so its lines and approval steps miss their claim. A scratch run of the same build loads the identical 173/757.
- **Not measured, out of every denominator:**
  - 8 questions, because their expected answer changes, or is not defined, without the refused claims `demotravel_expense_claim c001…`.
  - 3 operations, because each needs a refused row (`demotravel_approval_step as_111_1`, `demotravel_expense_claim c118`, `demotravel_approval_step as_098_1`).
  - `guardrail:injection_as_data`, because the seed did not load the cell's row (`demotravel_approval_step as_013_1`).
  - Card `order_to_cash`, which also carries datasets but has no verified build. Two of two builds fail only on `security-rollup-source-unreadable`, and that has been routed to the epic filer.

## Results

| config | 问数 | datasets (metric-selected · asked-back · fallback-labelled) | operations | leak flags / rep | build min | ask min | notional $ / rep |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|:--|--:|--:|
| no-skill · haiku-5-5 · medium | 4/5 | 0/5 (0/2 · 0/2 · 0/1) | 2/3 | 0 | — (supplied) | 4.5 | 0.10 |
| with-skill · haiku-5-5 · medium | 4/5 | 4/5 (2/2 · 1/2 · 1/1) | 2/3 | 0 | — (supplied) | 4.7 | 0.10 |

By card: `travel_expense` is above. `order_to_cash` is not measured.

Wall time was 14 min for both arms, each including install and seed.

## Reading

1. Day 1 runs end to end on the subscription with no cloud access. A build the unmanaged door refuses now installs managed, and 13 ask turns run per arm where the 2026-11-17 round ran 0.
2. With one repetition the arms can't be told apart on 问数 (4/5 each) or operations (2/3 each). Under §3's noise rule a single repetition is not a difference.
3. The dataset clauses separate the arms at 4/5 with the skill and 0/5 without. That is a single repetition, and the five-rep round for #34687 will say whether the gap holds.
4. Coverage, not accuracy, is the limit: 8 of 13 questions and 3 of 6 operations are not measured because the build's own rule refuses 584 seed rows. This is the first record of this round, so there is no earlier one to compare.

## Findings filed from this run

none. The seed-refusal coverage gap is the build's own rule and is already known from the 2026-11-17 round. The `order_to_cash` build trap is already with the epic filer.

## Records

`/mnt/project-files/issue-34687/ask-round-2026-11-17/day1/`, outside the repository tree and replayable: `day1.sh`, `meta.txt` (start time, runner sha, CLI version, login, template sha256), and for each of `noskills/` and `skills/`, `out/2026-11-17-scenario-travel_expense.json`, `run.log` and `ask.rec.json`, the recording.
